title: Houthis attack Saudi pipeline; oil supplies disrupted, stocks fall
summary: Houthi drone attacks forced Saudi Arabia's 745-mile east-west crude pipeline offline, reducing global oil supply by approximately 4% and causing crude prices to exceed $108 per barrel. Saudi Arabia subsequently cut crude supplies to European refiners for October.
takeaways: Houthis attacked Saudi Arabia's east-west crude pipeline
Pipeline capacity: ~4 million barrels per day (4% of global supply)
Oil prices climbed above $108 per barrel
Yanbu port stocks sufficient for only 5-7 days at pre-outage export levels
Houthis captured strategic Perim island in Bab al-Mandab strait
President of the United States attributed attacks to Tehran
